_comment: Photograph fetch pass for part 2 (p2c01-p2c11), 2026-08-22. Covers the two class-A rows in src/assets/licences.json, plus a re-audit of all seven class-B rows in those chapters. Every licence below was read off the file's own description page (Commons extmetadata AND the raw licence wikitext, or the Flickr photo page itself), never off an article that uses the file. Identity was confirmed against field, era and institution. Two class-C rows (p2c03 John Owen, p2c06 CCP Veritas) have no identifiable subject and were skipped. The 'reaudit' block below records what was searched for each class-B subject so the next pass does not redo it.

photo/p2c08-faust.png.subject: Craig Faust
photo/p2c08-faust.png.author: President's Commission on the Accident at Three Mile Island (Kemeny Commission)
photo/p2c08-faust.png.credit: Photograph from the Report of the President's Commission on the Accident at Three Mile Island, TMI-2 control room operators testifying, 1979, public domain (PD-USGov), downscaled
photo/p2c08-faust.png.modifications: downscaled from 603x596 to 480x474, converted to 8-bit greyscale (the source is a monochrome halftone), all metadata stripped, saved as PNG
photo/p2c08-faust.png.note: A halftone scan of the photograph on p. 95 of the Commission's report. Not a portrait: five men seated at a hearing table, l to r Ernest Blake (Met Ed counsel) and operators Fred Scheimann, William Zewe, Edward Frederick and Craig Faust. Faust is the foreground figure at the right of the frame. Kept as a PNG document image and not cropped, so the caption has to say who is who. Licence verified 2026-08-22: raw wikitext carries {{PD-USGov}} and the only cited source is the federal Commission's own report.

photo/p2c10-mcilroy.jpg.subject: M. Douglas McIlroy
photo/p2c10-mcilroy.jpg.author: Denise Panyik-Dale
photo/p2c10-mcilroy.jpg.credit: Photo Denise Panyik-Dale, Doug McIlroy at the Japan Prize ceremony, 2011, CC BY 2.0, downscaled
photo/p2c10-mcilroy.jpg.modifications: downscaled from 407x564 to 346x480, EXIF stripped, JPEG quality 82 progressive
photo/p2c10-mcilroy.jpg.note: Licence verified 2026-08-22: raw wikitext carries {{cc-by-2.0}} and no other tag. The file is an extract from File:Dennis Ritchie (right) Receiving Japan Prize.jpeg, whose Flickr source passed FlickreviewR as cc-by-2.0 on 2011-10-14. Identity confirmed: Bell Labs, photographed with Dennis Ritchie at the Japan Prize ceremony, Tokyo, 19 May 2011.

reaudit._comment: Class-B rows for p2c01-p2c11, re-checked 2026-08-22 beyond the original pass. Common baseline for every subject below: Commons file+category search (multiple phrasings), Wikidata entity search and P18 check, and the Openverse API filtered to license_type=commercial,modification, which indexes Flickr, Wikimedia, Smithsonian, NASA, Science Museum Group, Rawpixel and others. Anything further is named per subject. General web search engines (DuckDuckGo, Bing, Mojeek, SearXNG) refused scripted access; a browser-driven DuckDuckGo image search with the 'Free to Share and Use Commercially' filter was used where it added anything.

p2c01.subject: Peter W. Allsopp
p2c01.searched: Commons file and category search for 'Peter Allsopp' and 'Allsopp settlement risk'; Wikidata (no entity for the Bank of England economist, only unrelated namesakes); Openverse commercial+modification, 0 results; Internet Archive advancedsearch mediatype:image, 0 results. BIS and Bank of England publish photographs all rights reserved.
p2c01.concluded: Confirmed class B. No free photograph exists. Original call stands.

p2c02.subject: Seema Misra
p2c02.searched: Commons search ('Seema Misra', 'subpostmaster Horizon', 'Post Office scandal', 'Horizon IT Inquiry'); Commons allimages prefix 'Seema' (60 files, none her); Category:Post Office Ltd, whose only person is Sir Alan Bates; Wikidata Q131755638 exists with no P18; en.wikipedia article 'Seema Misra' exists and carries no portrait, only File:Royal Courts of Justice 2019.jpg; Openverse commercial+modification, 1 unrelated result; browser DuckDuckGo image search with the commercial-reuse filter, nothing of her. Checked the route that produced the Bates portrait (a frame from a Welsh Government YouTube video under the YouTube CC BY licence) and the Post Office Horizon IT Inquiry site, which is OGL v3.0 'except where otherwise stated' but publishes no photograph of her.
p2c02.concluded: Confirmed class B. Every frame of her is PA Media, Reuters or Getty. Original call stands. If a future pass wants one, the only live route is a CC BY YouTube frame; that needs the video's own licence verified, and none was found.

p2c04.subject: Imine, Molli, Oster and Rusinowitch
p2c04.searched: Commons and Wikidata for all four names (Wikidata items exist for Imine Q130850931, Molli Q95981581, Rusinowitch Q102420675, Oster Q117120678/Q133601202; none has P18); Commons Category:LORIA does not exist; Openverse commercial+modification for each name.
p2c04.concluded: Confirmed class B, with one near miss worth recording so nobody chases it again. Openverse surfaced flickr.com/photos/57446062@N00/5764960872, description 'Pascal Molli (LINA)', by Laurent Neyssensas, 27 May 2011. Licence verified on the Flickr page itself: license id 5, CC BY-SA 2.0, so it is genuinely free and the subject is the right Pascal Molli (LORIA/ECOO, later LINA Nantes). Rejected on fitness, not licence: he is photographed from behind at a projector screen, his face is not visible, identity cannot be confirmed from the image, and the no-crop rule means it cannot be salvaged. Nothing at all for Imine, Oster or Rusinowitch.

p2c05.subject: Larry Seese
p2c05.searched: Commons search 'Larry Seese' and 'Larry Seese AT&T'; Wikidata, no entity; Openverse commercial+modification, 0 results; Internet Archive advancedsearch mediatype:image, 0 results. No PD-USGov route: the January 1990 collapse produced an FCC inquiry, not a federal photographic record of AT&T staff.
p2c05.concluded: Confirmed class B. No free photograph exists. Original call stands.

p2c07.subject: John Nagle
p2c07.searched: Commons search 'John Nagle', 'Overbot', 'DARPA Grand Challenge team'; Commons allimages by uploader Nagle (20 files, all objects and diagrams, no self-portrait) and en.wikipedia allimages by uploader Nagle (17 files, all logos and posters); en.wikipedia User:Nagle, which identifies him and distances the namesakes but carries no photo; the en.wikipedia article 'Nagle's algorithm' and 'John Nagle', neither of which has a portrait; his own site animats.com, no photograph and no licence statement; Openverse commercial+modification, whose 'John Nagle' hits are the Closter NJ house and the military strategist John Nagl, a namesake trap.
p2c07.concluded: Confirmed class B. He is an active Wikipedian who has released dozens of his own images freely and has never released one of himself. Original call stands.

p2c09.subject: Masumi Yamada
p2c09.searched: Commons search in English and Japanese ('Masumi Yamada', 'Masumi Yamada seismology', 山田真澄); ja.wikipedia search 山田真澄 地震, no article; Wikidata Q89266816 exists with no P18; Openverse commercial+modification, 0 results; Internet Archive, 0 results; her own DPRI page at eqh.dpri.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~masumi/, which does carry a portrait (img/pic.jpg) under an explicit 'Copyright (C) 2006 Masumi Yamada, All rights reserved'; the DPRI institutional site, also all rights reserved.
p2c09.concluded: Confirmed class B. A photograph exists and is explicitly all rights reserved, so it is rejected. Original call stands.

p2c11.subject: Mark Steward
p2c11.searched: Commons search 'Mark Steward' and 'Mark Steward Financial Conduct Authority', which returns only the tomb of the sixteenth-century Sir Mark Steward; Wikidata, only that namesake Q53647409; Openverse commercial+modification, only the geograph tomb photo and an unrelated road race; Internet Archive, 0 results; fca.org.uk, whose footer reads 'Copyright (c) 2026 Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) All rights reserved'.
p2c11.concluded: Confirmed class B. No free photograph exists. Original call stands.
